title: Opened native histories survive an offline browser restart
description: Living D06 proof for roadmap item ri_b1bb5ad00e17. Select an owned fixture with FARMSLOT_NATIVE_STORE_PROOF, FARMSLOT_HOME, FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PROFILE, GATEWAY_PORT, FARMSLOT_UI_URL and FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT. The fixture labels twelve setup-time closed histories and their expected prefixes; this is not evidence of provider execution. Reads use the actual detached native host, gateway, conversation view and browser SQLite store. The helper selects real controls, restarts only its owned watched gateway and counts commands around a disabled Resume click and reconnect. No node or device is required. This does not prove native-owner isolation, idle reads, desktop or Companion. Generated evidence stays outside source via FARMSLOT_RUN_WEB_EVIDENCE_DIR.

proofTargets.claim: The actual native host supplies complete history to the real conversation view.
Opened histories retain the last 200 complete messages.
The browser SQLite store retains ten opened histories.
A new offline document restores the opened conversation.
Cold restoration preserves the exact saved time and visible age.
The actual Resume action is disabled while saved data is stale.
Current reads restore history and Resume authority after gateway restart.
Clicking the stale action neither sends nor replays a command.
